summary: Repaired the disproved ADM-27 backend truth by adding a permission-checked, paginated admin community-post listing with strict filters and an explicit administrative projection. Public community projections and behavior remain unchanged.

verification.notes: Strict admin community post query, projection, list data, and success-envelope contracts compiled.
API production and test TypeScript compiled successfully.
Six focused tests passed, including unauthenticated, wrong-role, missing-permission, strict-filter, pagination, safe-projection, ownership, and public-regression coverage.
Root lint and workspace checks passed with zero warnings; apps/api does not expose a separate lint script.
OpenAPI contains the admin post path and resolvable strict projection references.
Postman contains the permission-documented admin community post request and validates.
Changed OpenAPI and Postman JSON artifacts parsed successfully.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors while backend_093 was in progress.

scopeNotes: This is an authorized direct Backend truth repair required by the selected frontend_068 ADM-27 surface: the endpoint blueprint declared GET /api/v1/admin/community/posts, but runtime, contracts, inventory, OpenAPI, and Postman were missing it.
apps/api/src/server.ts is an explicitly justified integration exception required to pass the existing RBAC service into the persistent community runtime; no unrelated Backend feature was added.
The administrative projection includes authorId and moderation status only behind verified Admin authentication and admin:community.view authorization. Public responses continue to omit those fields.
No live MongoDB or provider test was run; the deterministic memory adapter and focused HTTP tests cover this repair boundary.
